tagline: Test a learning policy before it reaches a real student.
elevator_pitch: PolicyPilot is a browser-local decision-support tool for school learning-support teams. It lets a team compare synthetic learner profiles under the same policy before rollout, then export the assumptions for human review.
video_title: PolicyPilot | Test a school policy before it reaches a learner
